alert_log: checkout-api returns 503 under flash sale load; redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: max number of clients reached; pool wait p99=2100ms
correct_root_cause: The service opened a separate oversized Redis pool in every worker, exceeding the shared server connection budget.
correct_fix: Cap per-worker pools against the server-wide connection budget, reduce excessive workers, and monitor active clients.

alert_log: After Redis promotion, auth requests time out to 10.4.8.12; redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: connection refused; new primary is healthy.
correct_root_cause: Auth workers retained a stale DNS answer for the retired primary after failover.
correct_fix: Flush resolver state, recycle stale connections/workers, and lower application DNS cache TTL.

alert_log: order-events lag rising; kafka.errors.CommitFailedError: group has already rebalanced; trace shows synchronous tax lookup taking 9 seconds before poll.
correct_root_cause: Inline enrichment blocks consumer polling beyond max.poll.interval.ms.
correct_fix: Move enrichment to a bounded worker queue, reduce batch size, and confirm processing stays within the poll interval.

alert_log: invoice-api intermittently returns SQLSTATE 40P01; deadlock graph shows settlement locks invoice then payment while adjustment locks payment then invoice.
correct_root_cause: Two transaction paths acquire the same rows in opposite order.
correct_fix: Standardize row lock ordering in both paths and use bounded retries for deadlock victims.

alert_log: Redis CPU 99%, search p99 elevated; commandstats show 27 KEYS calls/s from nightly namespace cleanup; timeouts in redis.get.
correct_root_cause: A cleanup scan uses blocking KEYS against the full production keyspace.
correct_fix: Replace KEYS with rate-limited cursor-based SCAN batches and schedule cleanup off peak.

alert_log: tenant reports endpoint times out; PostgreSQL Seq Scan on audit_events (42M rows); query filters tenant_id and created_at, DB CPU otherwise normal.
correct_root_cause: The composite index required by the tenant and time filters was dropped during migration.
correct_fix: Create the composite index concurrently, verify the query plan, and add migration validation for index presence.

alert_log: Kubernetes shows OOMKilled and rising memory; initial suspicion is an unbounded application cache, but heap profile is flat and node memory pressure began after log-agent rollout.
correct_root_cause: The node log agent has a memory leak and evicts pods under node pressure; application heap is not growing.
correct_fix: Roll back the log-agent version, drain affected nodes safely, and add node-level memory alerts before changing application cache limits.

alert_log: JWT verification failures begin after key rotation; initial suspicion is stale JWKS cache, but verifier has fetched the new kid and issuer reports a 401 due to incorrect audience claim.
correct_root_cause: A deployment changed the token audience to the staging value, so valid signatures fail application audience validation.
correct_fix: Restore the production audience configuration and validate issuer, audience, and signature separately; retain the JWKS cache settings.

alert_log: New gRPC requests fail with status UNAVAILABLE; resolver returns an IPv6 address, but the service is bound only to IPv4 and no upstream health checks are failing.
correct_root_cause: A resolver configuration change prefers IPv6 while the application listener is IPv4-only.
correct_fix: Align listener and resolver address families or bind dual stack, then validate health checks over the selected address family.

alert_log: All scheduled jobs start exactly one hour late after a base image update; host clocks are synchronized, but the container timezone changed and scheduler interprets local wall time.
correct_root_cause: The image update changed the scheduler container timezone from UTC to a daylight-offset local timezone.
correct_fix: Set TZ=UTC explicitly, schedule using timezone-aware UTC timestamps, and verify next-run calculations before deployment.
